purpose: Prioritize global scientific products with useful missing portable native access; citation rank alone is insufficient.
timing: Written after exploratory web research and before evaluating the saved Source Cooperative snapshot against the expanded shortlist.
equivalence: Match scientific product, release, geographic and temporal coverage, variables/attributes, uncertainty and analytic precision.

Publicly accessible equivalent COG, Zarr/Icechunk, GeoParquet or indexed FlatGeobuf at any host defeats a generic conversion gap. Account requirements are access constraints, not evidence a format is absent.
GEE services, WMS displays, STAC metadata stored as Parquet and PMTiles visualization alone do not establish an equivalent portable analytic product.
A generic GeoTIFF or NetCDF label does not prove a conversion is needed. Inspect source layout and remote access before selecting raster builds.
A name/DOI search returning no match is bounded negative evidence, never proof of universal absence. Search hits are leads requiring exact-scope review.
ranking: Exclude known equivalent native access and unresolved restrictive redistribution terms from the immediate queue.
Prioritize scientific usefulness, global scope, associated-publication demand and meaningful access improvement.
Use release readiness and maintenance effort as practical ordering factors. Existing local work does not establish an external gap.
Keep exact source products separate when scientifically distinct, but disclose shared geometry and superseding products.

snapshot_acceptance.match_fields: All serialized record metadata, not hosted dataset bytes.
snapshot_acceptance.validation: Refuse a different snapshot; record matched IDs/titles and the actual terms matched; never auto-classify a hit as equivalent.

limits: This is a recommendation audit, not a new editable dataset inventory; canonical facts remain in datasets/*/dataset.yaml.
No data builds, downloads of bulk datasets, GEE jobs, uploads, catalog publication, or registry submission are authorized by this review.
No universal absence, complete coverage, correctness or full legal review is asserted.
